en: The postcard features a historical black-and-white photograph of a grand city square with manicured gardens, walkways, benches, and a prominent ornamental fountain at the center. The square is surrounded by ornate 19th-century European buildings with elaborate roofs, spires, and facades. The reverse side prominently displays Swedish text, script handwriting, and a Swedish stamp.
